strategy_roster.name: Ergodic Ticks Volume Indicator
strategy_roster.notes: The True Strength Index is approximated by the double-smoothed one-bar rate of change and its documented EMA signal line by a third smoothing, so the documented cross above/below logic is kept. Short Length 25, Long Length 13 and Signal Length 7 are explicit fallbacks because the parameters are listed without values, and the short leg is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Freeman
strategy_roster.notes: One RSI teacher block is translated: an oversold reading (RsiSellLevel 30) on a recent bar turning higher while the fast MA (FirstMaPeriod 10) rises. Every period and level is a fallback since none are documented, and the separate hourly MA/RSI filter, second teacher, ATR stop/target factors, pip trailing, pyramiding, LockCoefficient, session hours and Friday switch are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Limits Martin
strategy_roster.notes: The only market-derived element is the pending buy limit placed a Step below the last close, expressed as a one-bar dip of about 0.5% because Step, Stop Loss and Take Profit have no documented values. The paired sell limit, Use Martingale / Use MegaLot sizing, Loss Limit reset and Volume are order-book logic the single-position long engine cannot hold.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Slope Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: The documented volume swing band (VolumeMaPeriod 20, LookbackPeriod 20, DeviationMultiplier 2.0) is applied to a volume-flow z-score, and the long entry is the documented cross back toward the mean from below with the exit at the mean itself. StopLossPercent 2.0 is documented, while the short leg and 5-minute timeframe are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Divergence RSI
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= donchian_low(low,20) and roc(rsi(close,14),3) > 0 and rsi(close,14) < 50
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish MACD divergence is approximated by a fresh 20-bar low with a rising three-bar RSI change, and the documented RSI filter becomes the requirement that RSI(14) stays under its midline. All RSI periods, thresholds and the bullish fast/slow EMA lengths are undocumented fallbacks, and the pip-based BullishStopLossPips/TakeProfitPips and volume settings are not percent fields.

strategy_roster.name: Buy Sell Grid
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy always holds one long and one short grid level and re-opens the pair with geometrically larger volume when one side reaches TakeProfitPoints, so its direction comes from the hedge state rather than any market signal; the never-true close<0 guard is used. InitialVolume, VolumeMultiplier and MaxTrades need simultaneous positions.

strategy_roster.name: Trade EA Template for News
strategy_roster.notes: This is a template whose documented behaviour is to trade only while flat inside a news blackout derived from an external economic calendar; no market-derived entry condition exists in the docs, so the never-true close<0 guard avoids inventing one. The per-impact minute windows, NFP flag, timezone offset and the 100-point brackets are calendar and point settings.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Alert
strategy_roster.notes: The documented RsiPeriod 30 with OversoldLevel 20 and OverboughtLevel 80 is used exactly: the long side is the deep-oversold cross and the overbought cross exits. The alert notifications, the volume-adding reversal of an existing position and the 1-minute candle default are outside the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Combo Right
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is approximated by a 20-period z-score scaled to the documented CCI scale, with positive values favouring longs, and the buy perceptron's view of shifted price differences is approximated by short-term momentum. CciPeriod, the perceptron weights (x12, x22, ...), Pass mode, Shift and the tick-based TakeProfit1/StopLoss1 are not reproducible.

strategy_roster.name: Coin Flip
strategy_roster.notes: The direction is chosen at random on every new candle with no technical filter, and risk is handled by a martingale Volume multiplier, so no deterministic long signal exists and the never-true close<0 guard is used. MaxVolume, TakeProfit, StopLoss, TrailingStart and TrailingStop are price-step position-management settings.
